badges.description:
Hey. Axiom here.
So there really isn't a limit to how long you can make a badge description, so I decided to ramble on about stuff in here! Quite innovative, isn't it?
Yeah so Kosta's NEaT Inferno just got like 100 visits within 2 hours which might be a world record, which is ironic, as it was due to the April Fools 2023 Event. So far, I've gotten content into every area in KNI except AR (unreleased). So, I think I'm fine for now. Oh yeah. This was supposed to be about the mini tower. Alright so, I started this as a joke to make a "generic axiom mini tower", but the mini tower had to be exported from an old april fools area to the new one which you can play today, and when that happened, it was April 1st, so I had to speedbuild this version. There also used to be a skip to skip the 20k click button button. Fun fact, btw, this used to be actually catastrophic. (part of af23, unobtainable)
